_meta._note: Arcee Trinity family update — replace placeholder trinity-large-thinking entry with proper trinity-large-preview/base/truebase + add trinity-mini and trinity-nano (3 sparse MoE sizes). Initial release 2026-01-27 per Arcee blog (the 2026-05-01 placeholder date was wrong). Tech report arxiv 2602.17004 published 2026-02-19. Benchmark numbers from Arcee blog comparison vs Llama-4-Maverick Instruct.

models.name: Trinity Large Preview
models._source: https://www.arcee.ai/blog/trinity-large — Sparse MoE, 256 experts × 4 active, 17T tokens, $20M training cost, Muon optimizer, 2048 B300 GPUs × 33 days. Native 512k context, 128k via API (8-bit quant). Lightly post-trained chat-ready variant.

models.name: Trinity Large Base
models._source: https://www.arcee.ai/blog/trinity-large — Full 17T-token pretraining checkpoint (no post-training). MoE 256 experts × 4 active, 6 dense layers.

models.name: Trinity Large TrueBase
models._source: https://www.arcee.ai/blog/trinity-large — 10T-token early checkpoint with no instruct data — research artifact for studying capability emergence.

models.name: Trinity Mini
models._source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17004 — Trinity Technical Report. Sparse MoE, 10T training tokens. Same architecture family as Large: interleaved local+global attention, gated attention, depth-scaled sandwich normalisation, sigmoid routing, Soft-clamped Momentum Expert Bias Updates (SMEBU).

models.name: Trinity Nano
models._source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17004 — Trinity Technical Report. Smallest sparse MoE in the Trinity family, 10T training tokens, 1B active per token.
